current_affairs.title: Supreme Court Ruling on Article 39(b) and Private Property
current_affairs.summary: A nine-judge Constitution Bench ruled that not all privately owned resources can be classified as 'material resources of the community' under Article 39(b) of the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP).
key_takeaways: Overturns previous interpretations suggesting the state can acquire all private property for common good.
Establishes that private property can only be acquired if it serves a public purpose and meets specific economic and social conditions.
Protects individual property rights while balancing public welfare obligations.

current_affairs.title: India's Deep Ocean Mission and Samudrayaan Progress
current_affairs.summary: The Ministry of Earth Sciences highlighted key updates on the Deep Ocean Mission, including trials for MATSYA 6000, India's crewed submersible designed to explore polymetallic nodules.
key_takeaways: Aims to tap critical minerals like nickel, cobalt, copper, and manganese in the Central Indian Ocean Basin.
Complements India's Blue Economy Policy and sustainable ocean resource extraction.
Places India among a select group of countries (USA, Russia, China, France, Japan) with deep-sea crewed capability.

current_affairs.title: Great Nicobar Island Project and Environmental Impact Assessment
current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper III (Environment & Ecology) & GS Paper I (Geography)
current_affairs.summary: Debates continue regarding the mega-infrastructure project on Great Nicobar Island, involving an International Transshipment Terminal, airport, power plant, and township.
key_takeaways: Strategic location near the Malacca Strait strengthens India's maritime posture in the Indo-Pacific.
Concerns raised over impacts on the indigenous Shompen and Nicobarese tribes.
Ecological threat to primary rainforests, Leatherback sea turtle nesting sites, and coral reefs.

current_affairs.title: Implementation of PM-SURYA GHAR: Muft Bijli Yojana
current_affairs.summary: The central government reports accelerated adoption of the rooftop solar scheme, aimed at providing free electricity up to 300 units per month to 1 crore households.
key_takeaways: Promotes decentralized solar power generation and reduces grid dependence.
Provides direct financial subsidies to households to lower capital expenditure.
Contributes to India's Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) target of 500 GW non-fossil capacity by 2030.

current_affairs.title: Global Commission on the Economics of Water Report on Global Water Crisis
current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper II (International Relations) & GS Paper III (Environment/Water Security)
current_affairs.summary: A major international report warns that mismanaging global water cycles threatens more than half of world food production and could reduce global GDP by up to 8% by 2050.
key_takeaways: Distinguishes between 'blue water' (rivers/lakes) and 'green water' (soil moisture/evapotranspiration).
Highlights India's severe groundwater depletion and vulnerability to monsoon shifts.
Calls for redesigning agricultural subsidies that encourage over-extraction of water.
